name: robot-multi
author: octos
description: Control multiple AKA-00 robots simultaneously via natural language. Supports broadcast to all robots or targeting specific robots by name.

tools.name: robot_multi_control
tools.description: MUST be called every time the user requests robot motion — never skip this tool or reuse a previous result. Sends a real-time HTTP command to the physical robots. Each call is a new hardware action. Pass ["all"] in robots to broadcast to all robots, or a specific list like ["robot1", "robot2"]. Supports actions: 前进(up), 后退(down), 左转(left), 右转(right), 停止(stop), 抓取(grab), 释放(release), 捡球/捡网球(pickup_tennis), 停止捡球(stop_demo).

robots.description: List of robot names to control. Use ["all"] to broadcast to all robots. Example: ["robot1", "robot2"] or ["all"]

action.description: The motion action in Chinese or English. Valid: 前进/up, 后退/down, 左转/left, 右转/right, 停止/stop, 抓取/grab, 释放/release, 捡球/捡网球/pickup_tennis, 停止捡球/stop_demo

time.description: Optional duration in milliseconds, e.g. 2000 for 2 seconds
